subject: Copywriting
title: Selling the Dream, Not the Product
description: Learn Selling the Dream, Not the Product in one minute.

hook.text: Luxury brands never describe what they sell.

buildup.text: A Rolex ad doesn't list specifications. It shows a world leader wearing one.

discovery.text: Kapferer's luxury principle: the more you explain, the less luxurious it feels.

twist.text: Mass-market brands sell benefits. Luxury brands sell belonging to an exclusive world.

climax.text: Every luxury copywriter's rule: never sell the product. Sell the world the product inhabits.

punchline.text: Don't sell the watch. Sell the world of people who wear it.

quiz.question: What is Kapferer's luxury principle about explanation?
options: The more you explain, the less luxurious it feels
